implementation.name: PDP-1: Spacewar! (Analogue Pocket, spacemen3)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 49 HDL source files (49 verilog). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements the DEC PDP-1 running Spacewar!, giving machine_id pdp1, each checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/spacemen3/PDP-1/blob/main/LICENSE is the MIT License text, read verbatim -- hence MIT. hdl_language_id: 49 of 49 HDL files are verilog (49 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/Spacemen3.PDP1/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier Spacemen3.PDP1.
